tools.name: list_demandas
tools.title: List condominium demands
tools.description: List all demands from the Miragio Cacupé condominium tracked in the Notion database. Supports optional filters.

status.description: Exact status to filter by, e.g. 'Concluído', 'Em andamento', 'Não iniciado', 'Agendado', 'Orçamento', 'Aguardando'.

responsavel.description: Filter by responsible person name (case-insensitive substring).

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.title: Weekly summary of demands
tools.description: Return an executive summary with KPIs (total, completed, in progress, pending, urgent), plus counts by responsible, status and category for the Miragio Cacupé condominium.

tools.name: get_priority_demandas
tools.title: High-priority open demands
tools.description: List only the demands classified as 'Alta' or 'Urgente' that are not yet completed.
